title: Mixed Event — Screaming?! Welcome to the Forest of Wolves! — Episode7 Into The Slightly Dark Woods With Everyone

meta.Event: Screaming?! Welcome to the Forest of Wolves!
meta.Episode: Episode7 — Into The Slightly Dark Woods With Everyone
meta.Event Outline: The Miya Girls School Festival is fast approaching. Kohane was thinking about inviting the rest of Vivid BAD SQUAD and wondering what they could do throughout the day, but her class, 1-A, decided to do something An's not very fond of... A haunted house!

rows.Line: Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy
Class 1-A - Doorway

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
I'm so sorry, Kohane!
I had no idea that it was you inside that mask. Honestly, me running from you like that...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
No, it's okay!
I'm sorry for chasing after you the way I did. I feel awful about making you feel so scared...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
That's totally fine!
If anything, it ended up being good exercise!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Seriously, how did things end up like this...?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: But I'm glad that we were able to meet up. We can finally start seeing what your School Festival has to offer.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
So, what do you wanna do?
You still up for going inside this haunted house?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
O-Of course I'm going in...!
Kohane and her class worked really hard on it!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I-I'm a little scared... B-But I'll be fine!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: An...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Thank you...
Fortunately, I have a feeling that you're going to like our haunted house...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Because there's a way for you to enjoy it as a game.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: R-Really? What about that scary wolf?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Some other girls from my class made that and it's really only meant for guests who seem like thrill seekers. So, it's not like you'll have a bunch of those chasing after you.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Does that mean the wolves inside will look a bit more standard?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I kinda wanted to see the scary one in action... But I'm also kinda curious to see how they toned it down for the fraidy cats.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Don't worry! It's meant to be fun for everyone!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: So, I hope you guys enjoy it...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Kohane...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Okay...
Then... Let's go in!

rows.Speaker: Receptionist
rows.Line: Alright, we have four entering the forest!

rows.Speaker: Receptionist
rows.Line: But before you go, you'll get to choose to wear one of three hats! You can be Little Red Riding Hood, a young goat or a hunter!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hats...? What happens when we wear these?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh, how you go through the haunted house changes based on which you choose.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: If you're Little Red Riding Hood or a goat, it'll be a maze like a normal haunted house, and your goal will be to reach the exit.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: If you choose to be a hunter, you'll be given a toy gun that lets you shoot and chase away wolves.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Whenever you feel like you're in danger, all you have to do is point your gun at a wolf and say, “Bang!” Then it'll go away.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I see... Is this what you meant by enjoying this haunted house as a game, Azusawa?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: At the same time, I feel that things would become too unbalanced if we all choose to be hunters.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh, actually, only one person per group can choose to be a hunter. The rest will become Little Red Riding Hood or goats.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Then, An, you should be our hunter.
You'd feel better if you knew you could fight back, right?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Alright, Azusawa, you'll be our Little Red Riding Hood. Akito and I will be the goats.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Y-You can count on me!
I'll blast anything scary that comes our way...!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Okay!
Plus...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: If things get really scary, An, I'll be there to protect you!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
...!
Okay! Thanks, Kohane!
Inside the Haunted House

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
I-It's pretty dark in here...!
But some of these decorations are pretty cute...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, they did a good job of making it feel like a fairytale.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah, I should be able to handle...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Whoa! Kohane, is this your haunted house?!>

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Eep! M-Monster!
My gun! Where's my gun?!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
An...
That was just Rin!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Huh? O-Oh, you're right...
Sorry about that, Rin...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Relax, will you...?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Also, we're blocking the entrance, so we should probably proceed.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
W-Wait!
We should stick together and...
*Howl*

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: *Scream*

*Growl*
*Howl*

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: W-Wolf! I have to... Wait, huh?

rows.Speaker: Mischievous Wolf
rows.Line:
*Bark*
*Howl*

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: It's acting kinda goofy...

rows.Speaker: Mischievous Wolf
rows.Line:
Hm?!
*Howl*

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: It's raising its arms. Is it trying to intimidate us?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
I've seen a different animal do this before...
Red pandas, I think?

rows.Speaker: Mischievous Wolf
rows.Line: *Whimper*

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Haha...!
It's actually kinda cute!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
(*Gasp*
Thank goodness! An's smiling!)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (I'm so glad that I asked Minori to be a cute wolf for us...!)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Bye bye, Wolfie!

rows.Speaker: Mischievous Wolf
rows.Line: Woof♪

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Alright, that wolf seemed pretty friendly...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Yeah, I feel a lot better now!
This much I can handle!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hehe. Great!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: So, let's keep going!

rows.Speaker: Unfettered Wolf
rows.Line:
*Howl*
*Snarl*

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Wh-What's going on?!
That wolf seems pretty wild!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: An, your gun! Now's your chance!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: O-Oh, right! Bang!

rows.Speaker: Unfettered Wolf
rows.Line: *Whimper*

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
<You did it!
An, that was so cool!>

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hehe. You think so?

rows.Speaker: Cute Wolf
rows.Line: *Howl*

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
This one seems much cuter.
However, it doesn't seem like it's about to let us pass.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Heh heh heh. Just leave that to me.
Bang!

rows.Speaker: Cute Wolf
rows.Line: *Whimper*

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: How's that? I feel like a pro now.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yeah, An, you're doing great!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: This is so much fun! It really feels like a video game! I was kinda scared of them jumping out at first, but I've gotten the hang of shooting them!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I can probably handle whatever this place throws at me now!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: It's good to see that you're enjoying yourself, Shiraishi.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I mean, this is pretty mellow as far as haunted houses go. I guess this is about the level An can really handle.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Speaking of which, Akito, you don't seem all that bothered by the wolves.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: That's because I know they're not real. Especially the ones that look goofy and cartoonish. Those aren't gonna...
*Growl*

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Uhh...
That one sounded pretty real... Was that...?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: A real wolf...?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (I asked Shiho to do a little surprise for us since some of us don't seem to be scared easily, like Shinonome.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Hmm... These trees seem much more realistic. Your class has done an excellent job of recreating a dusky forest.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: B-But I have a feeling that something's about to...
*Growl*

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
*Gasp*
That sound...

rows.Speaker: Zombie Wolf
rows.Line: *Bark*

rows.Speaker: An & Akito
rows.Line:
Eep!!!
Whoa!!!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: W-W-W-Wait a second! That's the zombie wolf Kohane was playing earlier, right?!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Its fangs look real...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Try to calm down, Akito, Shiraishi.
You said just now that it's not real, yes?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Y-Yeah, I know!
A-An!!! Shoot it so we can...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
I... I... I...!
I know! But my hands are shaking too much!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Huh?!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh no...!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
An!
Pass me that gun!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: K-Kohane...?!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Here, put on my hat!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: O-Okay...!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Cool! You can do it, Kohane!>

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: So... I aim the gun at the wolf and...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Fire...! Bang! Bang!

rows.Speaker: Zombie Wolf
rows.Line: Guh...!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hey, I think you stunned it...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Is this our chance to head towards the exit?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Let's go, you guys!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Geez, that was scary...
My heart's still racing...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah, I feel pretty tired...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Hehe. Me too...
And it was my first time going in as a guest. That was really thrilling.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
So, how was it...?
Did you guys have fun...?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
It was super fun!
I don't think I've ever seen a haunted house like this one before!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: It was scary... But that wasn't a problem because you were there to protect me in the end, Kohane!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
I enjoyed it as well.
I didn't realize haunted houses could be so much fun.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah, our class did a slightly better one, but we never would've been able to put anything together like that last wolf...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
*Gasp*
Thank goodness...!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Sounds like you all enjoyed yourselves.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Hehe. I'm so glad for you, Kohane!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh, Minori, Shiho!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yeah, we did! Thank you both for helping me out!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Wait, does that mean...?
Were you both the wolves?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yup! I was the one that appeared in the beginning, and Shiho was the last one.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: What? That really scary one was you, Hinomori? Wow... You put on a really good performance.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Oh, I just tried copying how a real wolf howls... The wolf's head I think did the rest.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Yes, that mask is quite something.
Even when Azusawa was wearing it, I felt that it belonged in a horror film.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Yeah, I get what you mean...
But did you guys have to make it look so realistic?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Interesting...
I guess you're not as tough as you look.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: What? Hey, don't get the wrong idea.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Haha! You did great too, Akito!
Anyway, Hinomori, Minori, thanks a bunch!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hehe...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (I really wasn't sure what was gonna happen when I had to go chase after An...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (But I'm so glad we're smiling like this now.)
